mainEntity.name: How long does NAD IV therapy take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A session typically takes 1 to 4 hours, depending on the dosage and your tolerance.
It isn't painful. You'll feel only a mild prick when the IV goes in, and most patients find the session relaxing.

mainEntity.name: How soon will I see results?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many people notice better energy and clarity within a few days, though results vary with individual health.

mainEntity.name: Is NAD IV therapy suitable for everyone?

acceptedAnswer.text: It suits most people looking for better energy and wellness, but a doctor's consultation is needed to confirm it's right for your health.
